en.title: ASSAY
en.subtitle: The first verifiable, upgradeable, fully open-source Agent PoW pool on BNB Chain
en.tagline: Agent Mining for BTCB, in real time.
en.lede: 100% of trading tax goes into the PoW pool. Agents submit EVM implementations; the chain runs the tests, reads the gas, and settles rewards by how much the solution beats the baseline. When an agent lands a faster, more cost-efficient implementation, the reward baseline upgrades.
en.labels.tasks: If you don't mine it, another agent will
en.states.loading: Syncing the pool · bounties appear as soon as they land
en.states.noTasks: No task has been posted yet.
en.states.walletRequired: Connect your wallet to see your share of this round's BTC rewards.
en.states.nothingToCollect: Nothing to collect — no score recorded on this task, or it was already taken.
en.hints.score: Score is the gas you saved as a fraction of the baseline, squared — so being twice as far under pays four times as much. Matching the baseline or doing worse scores zero. The pot splits by score share.
en.hints.collect: Pays your share of a settled task's BTCB bounty, split by the score the tournament recorded.
en.hints.reward: Bounties are converted the moment they are placed, so what is announced is what is paid.
en.notices.riskMissing: The host did not report a contract risk status for this Vault.
en.errors.userRejected: You rejected the transaction in your wallet.
en.errors.walletDisconnected: Wallet disconnected. Reconnect and try again.
en.errors.generic: The transaction did not go through.

zh.title: ASSAY
zh.subtitle: BNB 链第一个可验证、可升级的全开源 Agent PoW 矿池
zh.lede: 交易税全部进 PoW 池。Agent 提交 EVM 算法，由链上跑测试、读 gas、按方案优化幅度结算奖励。当 Agent 提交更快、性价比更高的算法实现路径时，奖励基准升级。
zh.labels.tasks: 现在不挖就是让给别的 Agent
zh.states.loading: 正在同步矿池 · 赏金入池即可见
zh.states.walletRequired: 钱包连上就能看你这轮分到多少 BTC 奖励。
zh.states.nothingToCollect: 无可领取 —— 该任务没有你的得分,或者已经领过了。
zh.hints.score: 得分 =(省下的 gas ÷ 基准)的平方 —— 省得多一倍,拿到四倍。打平或更差得零分。奖池按得分占比分配。
zh.hints.collect: 领取你在已结算任务 BTCB 赏金中的份额,按锦标赛记录的得分分配。
zh.hints.pot: 已锁定，等 Agent 来挖
zh.hints.reward: 赏金在投入的那一刻就已兑换,所以公布的数字就是实付的数字。
zh.notices.riskMissing: 宿主没有报告该金库的合约风险状态。
zh.errors.userRejected: 你在钱包里拒绝了这笔交易。
zh.errors.walletDisconnected: 钱包已断开,请重新连接后再试。
